settings.intro: Lumen isn't a single dashboard — it's a full analytics stack that meets your team where they are, from governed reporting to ad-hoc exploration.

design.title: Warehouse & app connectors
design.text: Native connectors for Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, Salesforce, HubSpot, and 200+ more. Point, click, and your data streams in — no pipelines to babysit.

design.title: Live sync & refresh
design.text: Data refreshes on your schedule, from every five minutes to nightly. Your dashboards always reflect the latest state of your business.

build.text: Define revenue, churn, and CAC once, in one place. Every team sees the same numbers with the same definitions — no more spreadsheet arguments.

build.title: Row-level security
build.text: Control exactly who can see what, down to the row. Sales sees their region, finance sees everything, and the audit trail records it all.

launch.title: Natural-language queries

launch.title: Dashboards & alerts
launch.text: Compose live dashboards from any metric and set alerts that ping Slack when a number crosses a threshold you care about.

settings.title: Questions teams
settings.intro: Straight answers about setup, security, and what moving to Lumen actually takes.

items.question: How long does it take to get set up?
items.answer: Most teams connect their first data source and build a live dashboard within a day. The governed metric layer takes a few hours to define, and our team helps you model your core metrics during onboarding.

items.question: Do I need a data team to use Lumen?
items.answer: No. Lumen is built for self-serve. You connect sources with native connectors, define metrics in plain language, and your whole team can ask questions without writing SQL. Analysts can go deeper with the SQL editor when they want to.

items.question: How is my data kept secure?
items.answer: Lumen is SOC 2 Type II certified with SSO/SAML, row-level security, and a complete audit trail on every query. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and we never train models on your data.

items.question: Can I embed dashboards in my own product?
items.answer: Yes. The Enterprise plan includes embeddable, white-label dashboards you can drop into your product, client portal, or reports with a single snippet. Your customers see your brand, not ours.

items.question: What happens if I outgrow my plan?
items.answer: You can upgrade or downgrade at any time, and we prorate automatically. If you need on-prem or VPC deployment, custom SLAs, or dedicated support, our Enterprise team will build a plan around you.
